entries.title: Natural Sequence Farming Field Day at Banyula Farm
entries.description:
Learn how Natural Sequence Farming approaches water, soil and landscape restoration. Tarwyn Park Training introduces the five pillars, followed by a farm walk with Josh Wellman to see the work at Banyula.

When: Sunday 15 November, 9am–3:30pm NSW time. Arrive at 9am for a 9:30am presentation.
Cost: Advertised at $50; book with the organiser.
Bring lunch, drinking water, a hat and sturdy shoes or gumboots.
entries.locationDetail: Banyula Farm, 813 Booyong Road, Clunes NSW 2480

metadata.organiser: Tarwyn Park Training and Banyula Farm

dateEvidence.summary: Organiser booking page explicitly lists 15 November 2026, 9am–3:30pm, Clunes address and $50 ticket.

entries.title: Mullumbimby Community Market — November
entries.description:
Explore local plant stalls, upcycled goods, eco products, food and live music at Summers Park. Market proceeds support the Brunswick Valley Historical Society Museum.

When: Saturday 21 November, 8am–2pm NSW time.
Check the organiser’s wet-weather updates before travelling. Dogs are not permitted in the park on market day.

entries.title: Singing Our Future Into Being
entries.description:
Join a community gathering using collaborative songwriting, music and movement to explore hopes for a regenerative Northern Rivers. No musical experience is needed; the organiser welcomes all abilities and participants aged 15 and over.

When: Sunday 22 November, 2–6pm NSW time.
Cost: General admission is advertised as free. Reserve a ticket through the organiser’s Humanitix page.

entries.title: Fermentation Workshop: Native Australian Ingredients
entries.description:
Explore fermentation with native Australian ingredients in a hands-on workshop with Byron Fermentary at The Farm. Suitable for beginners; jars and ingredients are included.

When: Saturday 5 December, 9am–noon NSW time.
Cost: The Farm advertises $160 per person. Contact Byron Fermentary to confirm booking arrangements.
